# Original unit host proposal for the node-visit candidate

This is **source only**. It introduces no Go source, module, original test execution, recorder run or timing entry. The Chair must release execution separately. The four existing modules, qualified Go inputs, exact 6/7 overlays, original 18-test plan and all historical proof remain unchanged.

`run-unit.py freeze NEW_SOURCE_ID` admits the unchanged full-chain producer and its four modules, binds the exact original plan/test hashes, checks the array/source references and freezes these six host files plus the four gate-plan files. `run-unit.py run SOURCE_ID NEW_RUN_ID native|wasm baseline|candidate EXACT_TEST` proposes exactly one anchored whole test per child. It reserves one permanent module/test claim, uses an exclusive active lock, preserves partial failures and never retries a unit under another ID. No additional Go or Next build is required. The log parser requires the exact top-level start/PASS and terminal PASS, no skip/failure, and all seven original nested frame cases when selected.

The native process gets only the pinned Node path, one Go worker and a closed temporary-directory name; no recorder, screen or profile variable is inherited. Selected original test/helper sources contain no file or network calls. The actual GoJS host reads bound sources/modules with bounded read-only descriptors, supplies only console writes through the unchanged closed filesystem helper, rejects every Go file open before delegation, and permits no PCM sink. It reuses the unchanged post-exit helper and requires a clean Go exit, zero opened files/data and closed log-only receipts. Host evidence files use exclusive creation. This trusted private qualification adapter is not a sandbox for untrusted Go code.

`ARRAY-BOUNDS.json` preserves exact source declarations, hashes and payload arithmetic. Both already accepted targets report a 1,073,080-byte graph object sum. The largest audited fixed member is the 196,608-byte envelope tree; the guard peak array is 131,072 bytes and the partition response array is 98,304 bytes. A selected spectral helper allocates 65,536 bytes of samples and 131,072 bytes of FFT scratch. These values exclude concurrent graphs, allocation history, GC, stack/preparation copies and runtime memory; the array table is not additive to the graph sum.

The host proposes an additional **observed RSS** cap of 1 GiB for the native process or the Node GoJS parent including WASM, using Darwin resident-byte queries every 25 ms without spawning a monitor process. The SDK structure/order is pinned in the bounds references. A live query error, oversize sample or missing observation is RED. Oversize readings are retained before rejection. This polling is not an instantaneous hard memory ceiling. Go timeout 25 seconds, parent deadline 28 seconds, combined log 256 KiB, Node old-space 192 MiB, stack 8192 KiB and module 16 MiB remain unchanged. Every post-spawn operation, including selector construction and registration, is inside the owned kill/reap lifecycle. Registration/setup failures retain the primary error and cleanup result; spawn failure records no owned child. Group cleanup uses the original helper, with direct-child kill fallback on helper errors; denied group cleanup remains RED. These children run without timing and cannot supply benchmark evidence.

The recorder retains its original 200,000 base/800,000 high-frame counters and other caps. Separately reviewed whole-unit bounds remain 374,604 base/1,498,416 high-frame upper for each spectral test; tiny EOF/dither 213,882 base/855,528 high; naive gain comparison 1,000,000 high-rate calls; scalar envelope 350,000 clock/query iterations. The unit host selects the immutable functions; it does not invent recorder counters for them or shorten their rates, warmup, tails, bins or tolerances.

Source contracts use synthetic logs, resident readings, mocked process supervision and log-only JavaScript I/O. They do not instantiate WASM or execute an original unit. The accepted finite same-backend semantic streams remain distinct evidence. Cross-target state identity remains UNPROVEN, the 192 kHz steady deadline remains RED, and this candidate is unselected.
